meta.title: AgencyPro · Your AI does the work. Real people fill the gaps.
meta.description: AgencyPro works with Claude through MCP and with your systems through its API. Steps only a person should do can go to credentialed professionals, and everyone is paid fairly once the payment clears.
meta.ogAlt: AgencyPro: an AI workflow with one step handled by a real person

hero.badge: Works with Claude · MCP and API · Private beta
hero.title: Your AI does the work. Real people fill the gaps.
hero.body: AgencyPro plugs into Claude through MCP and into your systems through its API. When a workflow reaches a step only a person should do, like a professional review and sign-off, it can go to a credentialed professional, and the sign-off comes back on the record. Everyone who worked on it gets paid fairly, and no one ever pays it back.

humans.title: When your workflow needs a person, it gets one.
humans.body: AI shouldn't sign off on the books alone. Coming soon: send a step to a credentialed professional, a CPA or an attorney for example, and get a recorded, signed sign-off your workflow can trust.

steps.title: Your workflow asks
steps.body: When it reaches a step a person must do, your Claude or your system requests a human step through AgencyPro.

steps.title: A credentialed pro takes it
steps.body: A professional who holds the right credential, such as a CPA or an attorney, claims the step and gets the documents and context.

steps.title: They decide, on the record
steps.body: Approve, reject or ask for changes. The sign-off is recorded and signed, with who made it and when.

steps.title: Your workflow carries on
steps.body: The answer comes back to your workflow, and the professional's share goes into the same fair payout.

connect.title: Ask from Claude. Or call it from your systems.
connect.body: AgencyPro is a Claude connector built on MCP, with a REST API and webhooks underneath. Your Claude can log time, draft proposals and invoices, and check payments, all inside your agency's permissions. Today the connector runs locally with Claude Desktop or Claude Code; a hosted connector for claude.ai is coming.
connect.ask: Log 1.5 hours on the Acme website contract: fixed the checkout bug.
connect.reply: Logged 1.5 hours on the Acme website contract, with your note. It's in the audit log.
connect.example: Example. Local connector, invite-only: add it to Claude Desktop or Claude Code, pick your agency, and ask. It acts with your permissions only.
connect.apiInstructions: Check the reconciliation and sign off.
connect.apiNote: Preview. The connector and the API share the same operations; endpoint details may change before launch.

how.title: Pending until it clears. Never paid back.
how.body: Each person who worked on the job, from the contractor to the professional who signed off, gets a share of what the client pays. Every share stays pending until the payment fully clears. Then it clears and everyone is paid, or it doesn't and no one owes anything.

steps.title: Stack the rate
steps.body: Put everyone on the contract: contractor, recruiter, referral partner, PM, your margin. Each gets a set slice of every hour the contractor bills, locked when the work starts.

steps.title: Bill one clean invoice
steps.body: Hours get approved, the client gets a single invoice with a payment link. They see the total, never the split.

steps.title: Pending until it fully clears
steps.body: When the client pays, every share shows up as pending for its owner. It stays pending until the payment has completely cleared. Nobody fronts payroll.

steps.title: It clears or it doesn't
steps.body: If it clears, everyone is paid, for good. If it doesn't, no one is paid and no one owes a thing. You'll never have to pay money back.

split.heading: One client payment
split.captionPending: The client paid. Every share is pending until the payment fully clears.
split.captionCleared: It cleared. Everyone is paid, and no one will ever pay it back.

play.title: Build a rate. Watch the money find its people.
play.body: Nothing you enter leaves this page unless you share the link yourself.
play.buildBody: Drag any slider. Set a share to $0 and it drops off the contract.
play.streamsNote: Every share comes out of the same billed hour. Only the contractor's hours are billed; everyone else earns a slice of each one.
play.sliderLabel: {name}'s share of each billed hour, in dollars
play.summary: Of every {rate} billed hour: {shares}. {hours} hours make one invoice for {amount}, and nobody gets a cent until it's paid.
play.textPending: Every share shows up as pending the moment the client pays, and stays pending until the payment fully clears.
play.textCleared: It cleared. Everyone is paid in full, for good.
play.textFailed: It didn't clear. No one is paid, and no one owes anything. Nobody ever pays money back.
play.shareTitle: Show a contractor or partner what they'd earn.
play.copiedNote: Paste it anywhere. It opens as a payout receipt.

play.exampleNote: Example numbers only. You set every rate on your own contracts.

items.a: Credentialed professionals, such as CPAs and attorneys, who hold the credential a step needs. Human steps are coming soon: none is switched on for clients yet.
No. You bring your own Claude and add the AgencyPro connector. It acts with your permissions only, and we never run or bill you for the AI.

items.q: When does a share get paid?
items.a: Your share shows as Pending until the client's payment fully clears: a few days for a bank transfer, 60 days for an ACH debit, about 4 months for a card. Then it's paid, for good.

items.q: What if the client's payment doesn't clear?
items.a: Then no one is paid and no one owes anything. Nobody ever has to pay money back.
Their projects, totals and invoices. Never your team's names, rates or pay.
AgencyPro is in a private beta, by invitation. During the beta, payouts run in Stripe's test mode, so no real money moves yet. Pricing is set at launch.

roster.title: Licensed? Get paid for the steps AI can't do.
roster.body: Accountants, attorneys and other credentialed pros: take review and sign-off steps from AI-run workflows. The prep is done before it reaches you. You make the call, and your share is paid once the client's payment clears. You'll never have to pay it back.
